subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is the value of the digit </mtext><mn>7</mn><mtext> in the number </mtext><mn>729</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of each digit in 729.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The digit 7 is in the hundreds place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Therefore, its value is 7 x 100 = 700.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 700</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is the value of the digit 7 in the number 729?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place value of each digit in 729. Step 2: The digit 7 is in the hundreds place. Step 3: Therefore, its value is 7 x 100 = 700. Answer: 700.

solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: 'Five hundred' means 5 in the hundreds place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: 'Sixteen' means 1 in the tens place and 6 in the units place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Combine these to form the number 516.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 516</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: Which number represents 'five hundred and sixteen'?
solution_text: Step 1: 'Five hundred' means 5 in the hundreds place. Step 2: 'Sixteen' means 1 in the tens place and 6 in the units place. Step 3: Combine these to form the number 516. Answer: 516.
